aboutGame.title: What is Dragon Shelter?
paragraphs: Dragon Shelter is a cozy fantasy life simulation game about rescuing dragons and rebuilding the sanctuary they live in. You restore an abandoned farm, grow crops, gather materials, and craft habitats that match each dragon's climate, then cook meals that keep your residents healthy and growing.

The core loop ties creature care, facility building, and a light economy together: take in a dragon, assess its needs, place it in a suitable habitat, keep it fed and comfortable, then reinvest the rewards into new habitats and rarer companions. Our wiki breaks down every system with beginner walkthroughs, farming and crafting guides, and detailed dragon references.

explore.description: Eight Dragon Shelter modules cover the beginner loop, dragon care, farming, cooking, crafting, characters, updates, and long-term completion goals.

modules.name: Dragon Shelter Beginner Guide
modules.description: This module introduces new players to the core gameplay loop, including farming, dragon care, exploration, cooking, crafting, and rebuilding the shelter. It helps beginners understand the first steps and important early-game priorities.

highlights.detail: Intake: accept or hatch a new dragon to start the care cycle and unlock fresh goals
Assessment: check the dragon's needs and traits to decide which habitat fits it best
Placement: assign or build a suitable habitat, since mismatched housing drains happiness fast
Upkeep: feed, clean, and interact to sustain happiness and steady growth
Payout: collect rewards, eggs, and resources that fund the next round of expansion
Reinvest: upgrade one thing at a time so progress compounds instead of scattering

modules.name: Dragon Shelter Farming Guide
modules.description: This module explains farming systems such as growing crops, gathering resources, improving the farm, and using dragon helpers efficiently. It targets players looking for ways to optimize daily farm activities.

highlights.detail: Collect habitat output on every login so production never sits idle
Feed and comfort-check dragons once or twice a day to protect their output
Start new breedings as soon as cooldowns end to keep eggs coming
Move hatched eggs into the nursery close to your food production
Fill empty slots quickly, because even a mediocre dragon beats lost output
Reinvest in new habitats before cosmetics, since capacity compounds

faq.title: Dragon Shelter FAQ
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common Dragon Shelter questions about dragons, habitats, farming, cooking, and progression.

items.question: What is Dragon Shelter?
items.answer: Dragon Shelter is a cozy fantasy life simulation game where you rescue dragons, restore an abandoned farm and village, and build a sanctuary around them. You grow crops, gather materials, craft climate-matched habitats, cook meals, and befriend a roster of dragon companions.

items.question: How should beginners start Dragon Shelter?
items.answer: Finish the tutorial, build one basic habitat instead of several, and take in only two or three dragons at first. Set up food production before you need it, then expand one habitat at a time so your income keeps pace with your care load.

items.question: What do dragons need in Dragon Shelter?
items.answer: Every dragon needs a habitat that matches its temperature band, humidity, vertical clearance, and noise level. Feed each dragon its correct diet, quarantine new arrivals, and keep a steady daily routine, because temperament and habitat fit matter more than raw rarity.

items.question: How does farming work in Dragon Shelter?
items.answer: Dragon Shelter farming runs on a repeatable loop: collect habitat output on every login, feed and comfort-check your dragons, start new breedings when cooldowns end, move hatched eggs to the nursery, and reinvest currency into capacity rather than cosmetics.

items.question: How do I cook for dragons in Dragon Shelter?
items.answer: Gather ingredients on a fixed route, build your stations in order from campfire to cauldron, oven, and smoker, then cook dishes that match each dragon's flavor affinity. Feed before a buff expires so your dragons never lose growth time.

items.question: Where can I play Dragon Shelter?
items.answer: Dragon Shelter is available on PC through Steam, where you can also follow official announcements, patches, and community updates.
